about: Held-out labelled prompts for task classification (task-class.mjs). Labels were written and committed BEFORE the classifier was run on these prompts; the commit that adds this file contains no scores. Phrasing deliberately avoids copying the classifier's own trigger words where a natural paraphrase exists. Author bias: the labeller also wrote the rules, so this set is a regression floor, not an independent accuracy estimate -- the independent one is the maintainer's blind labels of their own prompts (never committed). Label = the category whose settings fit the task best: fix (make broken behaviour work), build (add or change behaviour), rewrite (restate or restyle existing text/code without changing behaviour), survey (understand or report on a whole area), locate (find one specific thing), explain (say how or why something works), unknown (none of these / chat).
